items.prompt: Which cash update is used after a successful match?

options.why: Requested limit notional is a conservative admission bound, not necessarily actual cost.

options.text: Subtract all initial cash regardless of fills
Debit the requested limit notional even when fewer units fill at better resting prices
options.why: Admission reserves a conservative upper bound; this simulation debits only actual filled quantity at resting prices.

items.explanation: Debit actual simulated fill cost while preserving request admission policy.
